# Third-party source provenance

Chen Liu, figures4papers: https://github.com/ChenLiu-1996/figures4papers
Pinned commit: b709de17da7e8f9a72e51a5de5bced924a01eeab.

The selected original source and skill/reference files are retained under figures4papers/b709de17da7e/, together with the original CC BY-NC 4.0 LICENSE and source_manifest.json. This is a selected source excerpt, not a full installation. No global skill/plugin was installed.

The static-figure adapter in ../build.py imports and calls the original mark_events function on this project's archived observations. Style adaptations include project data, portable font fallback, no invented error bars, zero-baseline model comparison, correct calendar spacing, editable SVG/PDF output, and a smaller selection of labels. The interactive HTML/SVG layer is separately implemented locally. Attribution is retained in the deck, comparison page and documentation. The upstream author does not endorse this project.
